overview.title: System overview
overview.intro: Is gezcez healthy? Health, trackers and recent events in one place.
overview.networkIntro: Live vehicles, trackers and data quality for this network.
overview.emptyTitle: Overview widgets arrive with the tracker
overview.emptyBody: KPIs, the tracker grid and live charts land once the backend serves them. The page layout and permissions are already live.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Every gezcez account. Search by name, username, email or ID.
users.noMatchBody: Try a different search or clear the filters.

user.notFoundBody: This account doesn't exist or was deleted.

profile.revealHint: Shows the full address. This is recorded in the audit log.
profile.activityBody: Everything done to or by this account is in the audit log.

roles.empty: This user has no dashboard roles.
roles.hint: Roles are global or per network. You can only change roles below your own level.
roles.selfHint: You can't change your own roles.
roles.addBody: Global roles need a recent sign-in. Network roles apply to that network only.
roles.globalHint: Global roles count in every network.
roles.levelHint: Only roles below your level in this network are listed.
roles.removeEffect: {{name}} loses {{role}} in {{scope}} and every permission that came only from it.
roles.failed: The role change wasn't saved. Try again.

moderation.notBannedBody: This account can sign in and use gezcez normally.

ban.title: Ban {{name}}?
ban.body: They are signed out everywhere and can't sign in until the ban ends. This needs a recent sign-in.
ban.publicReasonHint: 3 to 500 characters. The user sees this when they try to sign in.
ban.publicReasonError: Write a reason of 3 to 500 characters.

unban.title: Lift the ban on {{name}}?
unban.body: They can sign in again straight away.
unban.reasonHint: At least 3 characters. Recorded in the audit log.

sessions.revokeEffect: Signs the user out of {{app}} on {{device}}. Other sessions stay signed in.
sessions.revokeAllEffect_one: Signs {{name}} out of {{count}} session on every device and app. They can sign in again unless banned.
sessions.revokeAllEffect_other: Signs {{name}} out of {{count}} sessions on every device and app. They can sign in again unless banned.
sessions.failed: The sessions weren't revoked. Try again.

activity.empty: No audit entries for this user.

emails.note: Only metadata is kept: the content of codes and activation emails is never stored.
emails.empty: No emails sent to this user.

roles.title: Roles
roles.intro: Roles bundle permissions. A role can only manage roles below its level.
roles.builtInHint: Built-in roles can't be renamed or deleted.

form.body: Roles are global; you assign them per network. Saving needs a recent sign-in.
form.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and _. Can't be changed later.
form.name: Name
form.levelHint: 1 to {{max}}. A role can only manage roles below its level.
form.keyTaken: A role with this key already exists.

invalid.key: Use 2 to 32 lowercase letters, digits or _, starting with a letter.
invalid.name: Use 2 to 60 characters.
invalid.level: Pick a whole number in the allowed range.

form.failed: The role wasn't saved. Try again.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every admin action, who did it and what changed. Open a row for the diff.
audit.search: Search action, actor, target or request ID

detail.noChanges: No field changes recorded for this event.

audit.networkIntro: Changes made in this network: roles, tracker controls and settings.

role.notFoundBody: This role doesn't exist or was deleted.

matrix.title: Permission matrix
matrix.hint: Changes are staged until you review and save them. Arrow keys move, Space toggles.
matrix.readOnly: Read only: you need roles.write to change grants.
matrix.discardConfirm: You have unsaved permission changes. Leave and discard them?
matrix.reviewBody: Each change is applied on its own; any that fail stay staged.
matrix.reviewDangerous_one: {{count}} change touches a sudo or global permission (in red). Each change is applied on its own; any that fail stay staged.
matrix.reviewDangerous_other: {{count}} changes touch sudo or global permissions (in red). Each change is applied on its own; any that fail stay staged.
matrix.escalationWarning: You're granting a permission that lets holders change roles or permissions. Make sure the role's members should have that.
matrix.partial: {{ok}} saved, {{failed}} failed. The failed ones are still staged.
matrix.failed: The changes weren't saved. Try again.

disabled.immutable: Built-in role: grants can't be changed.
disabled.not_held: You can't grant a permission you don't hold.
disabled.level: This role is at or above your level.

permissions.title: Permission registry
permissions.intro: Every permission the backend registered at boot, with its routes and the roles that hold it. Code is the source of truth.
permissions.orphanBanner_one: {{count}} key has no routes since the last boot. Delete it once nothing needs it.
permissions.orphanBanner_other: {{count}} keys have no routes since the last boot. Delete them once nothing needs them.
permissions.deleteEffect_one: Removes the key and its grant from {{count}} role. It can't be undone; a deploy that uses the key again re-registers it with no grants.
permissions.deleteEffect_other: Removes the key and its grants from {{count}} roles. It can't be undone; a deploy that uses the key again re-registers it with no grants.
permissions.deleteFailed: The key wasn't deleted. Try again.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.intro: Active bans with their expiry, and every ban, unban, warning and note.

email.title: Email
email.intro: Templates live in the backend code. Preview them, send yourself a test, and follow deliveries and suppressions.

test.title: Send a test
test.audited: Sending to another address is recorded in the audit log.
test.failed: The test email wasn't sent. Try again.

suppressions.removeEffect: Emails to this address are sent again. If it still bounces, it comes back here.
suppressions.failed: The suppression wasn't removed. Try again.

members.title: Members
members.intro: People with roles in this network. You can manage roles below your own level.
members.empty: Nobody has a role here yet.
members.emptyBody: Add a member to give someone access to this network.
members.removeFailed: The role wasn't removed. Try again.
members.undoFailed: The role couldn't be restored. Add it again.
members.addBody: Find someone with a gezcez account, then pick their roles here.
members.findHint: Type at least 2 characters of their username.
members.findHintEmail: Type at least 2 characters of their username, or their exact email address.
members.noAssignable: There are no roles you can assign here.
members.addFailed: The member wasn't added. Try again.

apps.title: OAuth apps
apps.intro: Clients that sign people in with gezcez: redirect URIs, scopes, token lifetimes and secrets.
apps.search: Search by name or client id
apps.notFoundBody: There is no client with this id.

typeHints.public: No secret: for browser and mobile apps, which use PKCE.
typeHints.confidential: Has a secret: for servers that can keep one private.

apps.systemHint: A system client (the dashboard or the mobile app). It can't be deleted from here.

create.title: New OAuth app
create.body: Type and platform can't be changed later. Creating a client needs a recent sign-in.
create.failed: The app wasn't created. Try again.

general.title: Details
general.firstPartyBody: First-party apps skip the consent screen. Only gezcez's own apps should be first-party.
general.firstPartyEffect: People signing in to {{name}} won't see the consent screen any more. Every scope it asks for is granted silently.
general.thirdPartyEffect: People see the consent screen again the next time they sign in to this app.

apps.saveFailed: The change wasn't saved. Try again.

redirects.title: Redirect URIs
redirects.trailingSlash: Another URI differs only by a trailing slash. Both are kept as separate exact matches.

problems.https_required: Use https:// (http only for localhost with a port on dev clients).
problems.custom_scheme_native_only: Custom schemes are only allowed for native apps.
problems.wildcard: Wildcards aren't allowed: URIs match exactly.
problems.duplicate: This URI is already in the list.

rules.native: Exact match. https:// or a custom scheme such as gezcez://oauth/callback.
rules.dev: Exact match. https://, or http://localhost:<port> and http://127.0.0.1:<port>.

lifetimes.title: Token lifetimes
lifetimes.refreshHint: Renewed on use. Web 30 days, mobile 90. At most the maximum.
lifetimes.maxHint: Sign in again after this, however active.

secret.title: Client secrets
secret.body: At most two exist: the current one and, during a rotation grace period, the previous one.
secret.grace: Keep the old secret working for

rotateEffect.none: Creates a new secret and stops the current one immediately. Servers using it fail until updated.
rotateEffect.24h: Creates a new secret. The current one keeps working for 24 hours, then stops.
rotateEffect.7d: Creates a new secret. The current one keeps working for 7 days, then stops.

secret.revokePreviousEffect: The previous secret of {{name}} stops working immediately instead of at the end of its grace period.
secret.onceBody: This is the only time the secret for {{clientId}} is shown. Store it in your server's secret manager.
secret.stored: I have stored it somewhere safe

usage.title: Tokens issued per day
usage.empty: No tokens issued in the last 30 days.
usage.summary: Bar chart of tokens issued per day over {{days}} days: {{total}} in total, at most {{max}} in a day.
usage.caption: {{total}} tokens in total; busiest day {{max}}.
usage.revokeTitle: Sign everyone out of this app
usage.revokeBody: Revokes every refresh-token family. People have to sign in again in this app.
usage.revokeEffect_one: Revokes {{count}} active session of {{name}}. Its holder has to sign in again.
usage.revokeEffect_other: Revokes {{count}} active sessions of {{name}}. Everyone has to sign in again.
